message.reasoning_content:
need to identify crimes based on facts: Peng bought dead dogs of unknown cause, weight 3400+ kg, processed, commissioned Wang to transport 10+ times, sold dead dogs to Lu for 20k yuan. Also "非法买卖、运输、利用动物尸体罪" is in Criminal Law article 338? Actually article 338: "非法买卖、运输、利用动物尸体的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So likely crime: "非法买卖、运输、利用动物尸体罪". Also maybe "非法屠宰动物罪"? But they didn't slaughter, they bought dead dogs. So main crime: illegal trade of animal carcasses.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法买卖、运输、利用动物尸体罪<eoa>
